title: App manifest
description: This project's own name and description, plus what the platform granted this app. Injected by Architect at generation time; validated by backend/test/manifest.spec.ts. additionalProperties stays true on purpose: an app generated today must remain valid as the platform adds fields (forward compatibility is asserted by a test, not hoped for). Array items are strings for now — their final shape (name vs id vs object) is the Architect spec's decision, and widening a string to an object is a non-breaking schema change under this contract.

description.description: One sentence: what this app is for.

icon.description: The app's icon (an identifier or URL; the platform decides which).

tools.description: The wired tools this app may reach, granted by the workspace.

connections.description: The workspace connections granted to this app (e.g. an Elasticsearch or Redshift connection).

playbooks.description: The workflows this app may trigger through the SDK with an API key.

capabilities.description: The SDK capabilities allowed to this app. The vocabulary belongs to the (unbuilt) app-facing SDK; the field is reserved so a clone made today stays valid the day it ships.

env.description: The environment variable NAMES the Lambda expects deploy to inject — names only, never values. Must move together with backend/.env.example (constitution Article VI §3).
